facts.fact: The Konza National Data Centre, through the Konza Cloud Platform, hosts 145 of Kenya's 451 government institutions; it also hosts national government systems as SaaS and is planned to host remaining ministries, departments, agencies and counties.

systems.platform: Konza Cloud Platform; colocation and managed hosting
systems.owner: Government of Kenya (government data centre; contracting authority KoTDA)
systems.tiers: Uptime Institute Tier III Design and Construction

systems.platform: planned expansion to about 280-300 racks, 1-2 MW
systems.owner: KoTDA (contracting authority); private partner to be procured
